title: Spec 014 Durable SQL Control Plane Adapter

phases.objective: Provide a mysql2-compatible durable persistence adapter that reuses the canonical Spec 014 repository state machine and proves transactional CAS, immutable-plan replay, lease generation safety, append-only journals, reconciliation retention, and restart-safe aggregate readback without applying a migration.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A second repository instance reconstructs the same operation aggregate from SQL rows, stale lease generations and row-version conflicts fail closed, and no DDL or provider dispatch occurs.
steps: Create a mysql2-compatible SQL adapter over an isolated synthetic database and pass it to the existing canonical control-plane repository.
Persist an operation, immutable plan, approval, execution lease, prepared/result journal events, and reconciliation evidence through SQL transactions.
Recreate the adapter and repository over the same durable rows to simulate worker or runtime restart.
Read the operation aggregate and prove equality with the pre-restart aggregate.
Reject stale lease generation and forced row-version CAS conflict while rolling back the transaction.
Transition the operation and consume the immutable plan exactly once with idempotent same-run replay.
assertions: Every mutation executes inside a MySQL transaction and uses an advisory writer lock plus SELECT FOR UPDATE.
Changed mutable rows require row_version compare-and-swap and any CAS miss rolls back.
Journal and reconciliation rows remain append-only.
Lease generation is monotonic and a stale holder cannot renew a newer generation.
Restart reconstruction preserves operation, plan, approval, lease, journal, reconciliation, and aggregate digest.
The adapter contains no DDL, provider dispatch, credential access, filesystem access, or shell execution.
Migration apply and Production mounting remain unauthorized.

phases.objective: This slice adds no scheduler, queue, migration runner, or runtime mounting.
Restart-safe reconstruction and rollback are proven in the MVP journey; dedicated worker crash recovery remains a separate integration slice.
No live database schema or Hostinger target is modified by this adapter slice.
Migration apply, runtime mounting, provider dispatch, deployment, and Production readiness remain outside this PR.
